title: OncoGenerator-Endo: a synthetic clinical and proteomic benchmark for endometrial cancer (v1.1.0)
description: Fully synthetic endometrial cancer clinical records and protein log2 fold-change data (180 proteins; 1k, 10k and 100k patient cohorts and scenario variants with noise, class imbalance, batch effects and missing values) with ground-truth labels. Generated by the open-source OncoGenerator code. All data are synthetic and must not be used for biological or clinical conclusions.
